description: This file defines the 'Cron' model class within the OpenCart admin system, providing methods to create, read, update, and delete cron job records in the database.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Model class for managing cron jobs, providing methods to add, delete, update, and retrieve cron records from the database.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Creates a new cron record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by its code from the database.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the 'date_modified' timestamp of an existing cron record by ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a cron record by ID.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves a specific cron record by ID.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a cron record by its code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Fetches a list of cron records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total number of cron records in the database.
